Theorem
[scalar upper and lower bounds] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0030 ↗ thm:chow-ii-scalar-wmp 1. ch10:10.3\group Scalar maximum principles

If $Lu=0$ and $c_1\le u(\cdot ,0)\le c_2$, then the ODE solutions $\phi _i'=F(\phi _i,t)$, $\phi _i(0)=c_i$, satisfy $\phi _1(t)\le u(x,t)\le \phi _2(t)$.
Proof

↗ thm:chow-ii-scalar-wmp \sketch Apply the scalar principle to $u$ for the upper bound and to $-u$ with the reversed comparison for the lower bound.

□
